{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.02
|arg= local
|eff= global

|gr1= PhysX

|descr= Changes the center of mass of an object smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero (or using the alternative syntax) means an immediate change.

|s1= myObject [[setCenterOfMass]] [centerOfMass, time]

|p1= myObject: [[Object]]

|p2= centerOfMass: [[Position#PositionRelative|PositionRelative]] - relative to the model centre

|p3= time: [[Number]] - transition time, 0 for instant center of mass transfer

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= myObject [[setCenterOfMass]] centerOfMass

|p21= myObject: [[Object]]

|p22= centerOfMass: [[Position#PositionRelative|PositionRelative]] - relative to the model centre

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>myObject setCenterOfMass [[0,-1,0], 0.5];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>myObject setCenterOfMass [0,-1,0];</sqf>

|seealso= [[getCenterOfMass]] [[setMass]] [[getMass]]
}}
